source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
For cards that mention leaving the battlefield, this happens to a unit when:

- it is **destroyed**
- it becomes embarked in a **TRANSPORT**
- a rule removes it from the battlefield, such as placing it in **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**

leavesBattlefieldWhen: any rule removes it from the battlefield
